answer: A vouching graph gates admission: a new agent joins only when two established agents bond a vouch for it, and trust decays with each hop, so identities sprouting like vine along a river inherit almost none of their root's credibility. When a vouched node cheats, its vouchers forfeit their bonds and every node downstream loses weight, draining an entire counterfeit lagoon at once. Forging N sybils then costs N scarce human-grade relationships or N forfeited bonds.
